title: Amplex Red Hydrogen Peroxide Assay
author: Opentrons
materials: The reagents that are kept in different deck slots are 5X Reaction buffer, distilled water,3%H2O2, HRP, Amplex Red and 1mM PMA.

steps.title: Configure run parameters
steps.instruction: Set the number of samples between 5 and 12 and select the P300/P20 mount (left or right) for the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Label and store deck reagents
steps.instruction: Place the following reagents in the indicated deck slots: 5× Reaction buffer, distilled water, 3 % H₂O₂ (kit stock), HRP, Amplex Red, and 1 mM PMA.

steps.title: Pick up 200 µL tips
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2, pick up a fresh 200 µL tip from Slot 4.

steps.title: Prepare 1× reaction buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute the 5× Reaction buffer with distilled water to a final 1× concentration (volume as required for downstream steps).

steps.title: Make 20 mM H₂O₂ stock
steps.instruction: Dilute the 3 % H₂O₂ kit stock with distilled water to obtain a 20 mM H₂O₂ working solution; store the solution in an Eppendorf tube rack in Slot 7.

steps.title: Create H₂O₂ standard curve
steps.instruction: From the 20 mM stock, prepare standards ranging from 0 µM to 2 µM in the Eppendorf rack (Slot 7) and dispense the appropriate volumes into Rows 0 and 2 of the 96‑well plate (on the temperature deck) using 200 µL tips.

steps.title: Prepare Amplex Red‑reaction buffer‑HRP
steps.instruction: Mix Amplex Red, 1× Reaction buffer, and HRP in Slot 11 to generate the working reagent; keep the mixture protected from light until use, then transfer it to location B1 of the Opentrons 10‑Tube Rack.

steps.title: Remove cell culture medium
steps.instruction: Manually aspirate all medium from wells E1–E7, F1–F7, and G1–G7 of the 96‑well plate containing THP‑1 cells.

steps.title: Add PMA to cells
steps.instruction: Place the plate back on the temperature deck set to 23 °C and add the appropriate PMA concentrations (0–150 ng/mL) to each well as prepared in the PMA dilution step.

steps.title: Add 50 µL working reagent
steps.instruction: Retrieve the dark‑stored working reagent from B1 and dispense 50 µL into each well containing standards or THP‑1 cells.

steps.title: Incubate and record fluorescence
steps.instruction: Set the temperature deck to 37 °C; at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min read fluorescence on a Biotek H1 plate reader (excitation 530 nm, emission 590 nm).
